description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Validator, which performs validation on HTMLPurifier configuration schema interchange objects, including directives, IDs, and aliases.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Validator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating HTMLPurifier configuration schema interchange objects, directives, IDs, aliases, and value aliases.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with a new instance of HTMLPurifier_VarParser.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a fully-formed interchange object, checking directives and their IDs.

methods.name: validateId
methods.description: Validates an interchange ID object, ensuring it is of the correct type and has a non-empty key.

methods.name: validateDirective
methods.description: Validates a directive object, including its ID, description, type, default, allowed values, value aliases, and other properties.

methods.name: validateDirectiveAllowed
methods.description: Validates the 'allowed' property of a directive, ensuring it is a lookup and default value is permitted.

methods.name: validateDirectiveValueAliases
methods.description: Validates the 'valueAliases' property of a directive, ensuring aliases are strings and correctly mapped.

methods.name: validateDirectiveAliases
methods.description: Validates the 'aliases' property of a directive, ensuring no collisions with existing directives or aliases.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates a ValidatorAtom for validating simple member variables of objects.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Emits an error with contextual information, throwing an exception.

methods.name: getFormattedContext
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current validation context for error messages.
